question: When did the Pro Wrestling League start in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2015**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Pro Wrestling League (PWL) was launched in India in the year **2015**.
 
• It was initiated by **ProSportify** and the Wrestling Federation of India (WFI).
 
• PWL features top Indian and international wrestlers competing in a league format.
 
• The inaugural season of the league started on **10th December 2015**.
 
• PWL has been instrumental in popularizing wrestling as a sport in India and providing a platform for wrestlers to showcase their talent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wrestling Federation of India (WFI):**

 
 
• It is the governing body for wrestling in India, affiliated with the International Wrestling Federation (UWW).
 
• WFI is responsible for organizing national-level tournaments and selecting athletes for international events.
 
 
 
• **League Format:**
 
 
• PWL follows a franchise-based system with teams representing different cities.
 
• Each team consists of both Indian and international wrestlers, including male and female participants.
 
 
 
• **Impact of PWL:**
 
 
• PWL has enhanced the visibility of wrestling in India and inspired young athletes to pursue the sport.
 
• It has also provided financial benefits to wrestlers through contracts and prize money.
 
 
 
• **Notable Wrestlers:**
 
 
• Top Indian wrestlers such as Bajrang Punia, Vinesh Phogat, and Sakshi Malik have participated in PWL.
 
• International stars like Olympic medalists and world champions also compete in the league.
